en.title: Maximize Beauty
en.description:
The beauty of an array is the number of 1-based positions i with arr[i]=i. You may repeatedly delete any element, as long as the array keeps a length of at least 1, and the order does not change. Find the maximum possible beauty.

This site uses a standard input/output protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n; the second line contains n positive integers. 1≤n≤2000, 1≤arr[i]≤10^5.
en.explanation: The DP state dp[k] is the maximum beauty when a subsequence of length k is chosen from the current prefix. When the current element is kept, its new position is k+1, which determines whether it scores; update in reverse order to avoid choosing it more than once.
